title: Crowns of Craft
notes: Every Crown of the Rogue, Shaman, Artificer and Alchemist can now be grown in the Tree of Life: 41 new ones.

Rogue: Unseen (3 critical hits out of Vanish without breaking it), Night Walker (Shadow Step leaves a fighting shadow), Blade Dance, Death by a Thousand (the hit streak lasts until you're hit; every 50th hit is a triple crit), Twin Storm (both blades at full damage), Killing Field, Clockwork Sentries, Plague Lord, Black Lotus, The Contract, Death Mark and Brand of Many.

Shaman: Storm Circle, Mvrow's Hunt (a spirit beast runs your totems), Mountain's Fall, Living Earth, Lifius's Grove, Evergreen (heals over time last while allies stay near), Foresight (the first hit of a telegraphed attack misses), The Spirits Know and Fate's Thread.
Artificer: Fortress Line, Junk Titan, Sentry Grid, Colossus, Swarm Logic, Mech Suit, Redline, Power Grid, Clockwork Heart and Prototype (a new experimental gadget every Ascension).

Alchemist: Masterwork, Twin Crucibles, Cluster Bomb, Endless Reaction, Lingering Reaction, Apex Mutation (three Mutagens at once), Elixir of Many, Golden Touch, Masterpiece and Perfect Distillation (unstable brews react in full, twice as wide).
